nodes.label: Loading mode for remote or local HTML
Redirect mode with HTTP 302 to HTTP(S) URLs
Private pages/ file boundary
nodes.rationale: Local HTML files are restricted to pages/ to prevent configured paths from reading other project files. The private directory is not exposed as public page URLs.

nodes.label: Local White page fallback on API, IP, or page failure
Original remote URL as HTML base
nodes.rationale: Loaded remote pages retain their original URL as the HTML base so relative assets resolve against the remote page.

nodes.label: Explicit proxy IP trust configuration
nodes.rationale: Proxy mode requires the proxy to overwrite X-Real-IP with the actual visitor IP and restrict Node.js connections to the proxy. Missing, duplicate, or invalid IP headers produce the local White page; deployment platform and NODE_ENV do not automatically enable proxy headers.

token_usage_note: AST uses zero model tokens. Semantic agent usage was not exposed; input_tokens/output_tokens zero fields are unmeasured placeholders.
